kind: Commercial racing-game replay of the Japanese Grand Prix. Appearance reference only. Pixels and meshes are not shipped.

frames_reviewed.view: Aerial of the pit straight, main grandstand and the wheel side of the venue.
Track map. Figure-eight, back straight across the middle, wheel beside the pit straight.
Cockpit on the pit straight. Stands on both sides, grass verge, barriers, light downhill.
Pit straight again. Pit wall one side, large grandstand the other.
Uphill S curves. Red and white kerb, grass, trees, a stand in the distance.
Long straight with power lines and a grandstand.
Wheel ahead, white rim and red cabins, stands and a red-white kerb.
